title: Nodes at a circuit layer
statement: For a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices and $L$ gates, the node type at layer $d$ is the set of indices $�\mathrm{Fin}(n+d)$ when $d\le L$, and is a singleton when $d>L$, where $d$ ranges over the indices from $0$ through $L+1$.
